newsitem.title: USA: Northeast Utilities to settle holders suit.
newsitem.headline: Northeast Utilities to settle holders suit.

text.p: Northeast Utilities said Wednesday it agreed in principal to settle seven derivative lawsuits and one demand letter filed by shareholders.
Under the agreement, insurers for certain of NU's present and former officers and trustees will pay NU $25 million, less attorney's fees.
In addition, NU has agreed to create a committee of trustees to oversee the board. The trustees on this committee will not be employees of NU.
The company said it agreed to the settlement "to avoid the time, expense and distraction of prolonged litigation."
